title: EFC vs Stage-III Cosmology State Assessment
abstract: Stage-III weak-lensing recalibrations (KiDS Legacy; HSC Y3 with DESI clustering-z) move S8 upward and reduce prior LSS–CMB growth tension to sub-1σ. This methodology/validation update repositions Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) from a tension-resolution narrative to a precision structural competitor, introduces the Structural Coherence Evaluation (SCE) protocol distinguishing O-layer vs M-layer quantities, and notes that the BAO-locked background coupling β = 0.08 yields σ8 ≈ 0.805, consistent with the converging Stage-III landscape.
